name: Share link management
summary: Creating a share link for the current project view, and listing, expiring, disabling, re-enabling and deleting share links.

roles.note: Grants follow SRC-004. Delete also needs the admin role by name, unless the user holds a grant on that share key (SHARE-REQ-006).

nfr.statement: Time between a share link's expiry or disabling and the moment it stops opening.

requirements.title: Generate and copy a share link for the current view
requirements.statement: From the Share icon in a project view, a user opens a pop-up where they generate a link to that view and copy it. No link is created until the user confirms.

acceptance_criteria.given: A user with create-share-links in a project view
acceptance_criteria.when: They choose Share and then copy the link
acceptance_criteria.then: A link to that view is created and copied to the clipboard

requirements.title: A share link records one project view
requirements.statement: Creating a share link needs create-share-links. The link records the project, its type (Structure by default, or Snapshot), the structure, the date and matching snapshot (each found from the other when only one is given), the viewer state, and who created it. The creator gets their own grant on the new link.

requirements.title: Share links can expire
requirements.statement: Users can set and change an expiry date on a share link. An expired link no longer opens, even if expiry fell while the system was down, and users are notified before their links expire. The link list shows each link's type and expiry.

requirements.title: Disabling is reversible; deleting is a soft delete with a narrower rule
requirements.statement: Disabling a link switches it to inactive and can be undone. Deleting marks it deleted. Both need delete-share-links on the project. Delete then also needs one of the user's project roles (direct or through a group) to be named admin and hold delete-share-links, or a grant on that share key, which the creator gets.

requirements.title: Disable, reactivate and revoke share links
requirements.statement: Users can disable a share link so it can't be opened until it is reactivated. Turning off public sharing for a project revokes every existing link at once and blocks new ones, and anyone opening a revoked link is told it is no longer valid.

requirements.title: Share link list, with Track3D staff shown as TRACK3D
requirements.statement: The list shows a project's links that aren't deleted, searchable by breadcrumb or creator name, sortable and paged. Links made by Track3D support users show the creator as TRACK3D to anyone not in support mode.
